warnings: Steel mono-pitch roof (หลังคาเมทัลชีท บุฉนวนโฟม PU), low side grid 1, high side grid 2 (A-04 slope arrows, A-07 section A). Members from the sheet's หมายเหตุ legend: dash-dot = อะเส 2C-100x50x20x2.3 (grid 1, top +5.85), long dash-short = TRUSS T1 (grid 2), heavy long dash-dot = TRUSS T2 (rows A, B, C), solid = จันทัน C-100x50x20x2.3, thin grey = Square Tubes 50x50x1.2 @1.50 (purlins).

T2 trusses span grid 1 (bearing on the อะเส over columns A1/B1/C1) to grid 2 (framing into T1 — the T1 elevation draws T2 at its three supports). T2 top chords overhang 1.30 to both roof edges (1' / 2'), recorded as their own top-chord segments.

อะเส (grid 1) and the T1 line (grid 2) are drawn to the roof edges A' / C' (1.00 overhangs). The อะเส overhangs carry the edge rafters; the T1 elevation shows no overhang, so the two T1-line overhang segments are kept at confidence 0.6 and flagged rather than dropped or promoted.

Rafters (จันทัน) are the four solid lines along x — the two roof edges A' / C' and the lines at A''''' (1.75) and B''' (5.00) printed by the 1.75 + 1.75 / 1.50 + 1.50 chains; the arrowed leader marks each one. Purlins are the thin lines along y: 6 drawn (incl. both roof-edge lines) at about 1.22 m spacing although the legend prints @1.50 m — count is the drawn number, spacing is the printed one.
Rafters and purlins carry no mark: element_id null with element_name_assigned (section 0.2). Square Tubes / rectangular tube are recorded with designation SHS / RHS and the print kept in printed_as.
